{{Top|leg}}
The '''Interstellar Strike Force''' was a mercenary organization run by members of the [[Adnerem]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Adnerem who ran it were all [[sterisi]], members of the same [[steris]], the name given to an Adnerem family unit. The Adnerem would manage the organization and hired highly skilled members of other species to act as the soldiers.<ref name="AE">{{JournalCite|11|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Interstellar Strike Force was first mentioned in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11]] as part of the [[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]] article series in the [[Adnerem]] [[Species/Legends|species]] entry. The source book was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1996]] as a supplement for their Star Wars [[Roleplaying game]].
